name: Power tool battery platform and accessory interface compatibility
description: Which power tool batteries, chargers, adapters and accessory interfaces work with which tools and brands, drawn from the manufacturers' own pages: Milwaukee M18, DEWALT 20V MAX/FLEXVOLT and the DCA1820 18V adapter fit table, RYOBI 18V ONE+, Makita LXT/XGT and the ADP10 charger adapter, the Bosch-led AMPShare alliance, the Metabo-led Cordless Alliance System (CAS), the Bosch/Fein Starlock oscillating multi-tool interface, and Heller's drill-bit shank interface guide. Answers 'does a FLEXVOLT battery work in a 20V MAX tool', 'which brands share the AMPShare / CAS 18V battery', 'will the DCA1820 adapter fit tool model X', and 'is a Starlock blade backward compatible with OIS tools' — questions where the wrong answer means a tool that will not run or a battery that will not charge.
licence: Factual compilation with source citations. Compatibility facts are taken from the manufacturers' and alliance operators' own published pages with a short attributed quote linking back; no compilation is reproduced.
